title: The Corner Kick (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational absurdist 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal football set piece chaos
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The corner kick is hope
Compressed into an arc
Eleven men moving into the box
With entirely different ideas
About where the ball is going to land

[Verse 2]
The set piece was practised on Tuesday
Everyone knows their run
Everyone knows the delivery
Nobody remembers any of it once the crowd starts
And the ball leaves the boot at a slightly different angle than rehearsed

[Chorus]
The corner says — everyone into the box
The corner says — find your man
The corner says — near post flick-on
The corner says — second ball
Somewhere between all of those instructions
The ball arrives
And two very large men jump at the same time
And one of them gets it
And it goes somewhere

[Bridge]
Chas loved the corner kick
Said — it's the only moment in football
Where chaos is officially scheduled
Where the rules say — yes, now, everybody go
And see what happens

[Verse 3]
The short corner is a different philosophy entirely
The short corner says — we've thought about this
The short corner says — we don't want chaos
We want an angle
The crowd groans at the short corner
Because they came for the chaos
And they didn't get it

[Outro]
The corner kick
The corner kick
That's my boy
